PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control Program for Type 2 Diabetes (Metabolic Health Focus)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary fat_loss:
    name "Fat loss with improved glycaemic control and metabolic health"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full-Body Foundations & Glycaemic Strategy":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          ab_wheel 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression & Glycaemic Modulation":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x30 seconds rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Hypertrophy Emphasis with Cardio Acceleration":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          farmer_walk 2x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Fat-Burning Circuit x Cardio Finisher":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          jump_rope 1x60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_raise 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Conditioning & Diabetes-Focused Adaptations":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          barbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spine_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Volume & Glycemic Synergy":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chest_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x40 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes

NUTRITION STRATEGY (diabetes-aware, designed to pair with training plan)
- Calorie target: moderate deficit of ~500 kcal/day from estimated maintenance; adjust weekly based on weight trend (aim ~0.5–1.0 kg fat loss/week). Reassess every 4 weeks.
- Macronutrient distribution (daily, adjustable):
  - Protein: 1.6–2.0 g/kg bodyweight (to support lean mass and satiety)
  - Carbohydrates: 2.5–3.0 g/kg bodyweight (adjust for glycemic response; emphasize low-EDGI sources)
  - Fat: remaining calories; prioritize unsaturated fats
- Carbohydrate guidelines (diabetes-sensitive):
  - distribute evenly across meals and workouts
  - prefer complex carbs: whole grains, legumes, vegetables, fruits with fiber
  - target 25–40 g fiber/day from vegetables, fruits, whole grains, legumes
  - monitor postprandial responses; consider a small, balanced carb portion before training if needed
- Meal timing and structure:
  - 3 main meals + 1–2 small snacks if needed to meet protein target
  - pre-workout snack 1–2 hours before training if training intensity >60 minutes or if fasting glucose is high; options: small apple with 1–2 tbsp peanut butter; Greek yogurt with berries
  - post-workout protein + carb within 2 hours: e.g., whey or plant-based protein + fruit or rice cakes
- Glycemic targets (general):
  - fasting glucose: target 90–130 mg/dL
  - pre-meal: 90–130 mg/dL
  - post-meal: <180 mg/dL 2 hours after start of meal
- Metformin considerations:
  - consistent meal times with medication; avoid very high-fat meals around dosing causing GI upset
  - hydration and B12 awareness (per clinician guidance)
- Hydration:
  - 30–35 ml/kg bodyweight daily; add extra around workouts
- Supplements (as advised by clinician):
  - vitamin D if deficient
  - magnesium/potassium as needed for balance (within medical guidance)
- Monitoring:
  - weekly weigh-ins; biweekly body composition if possible
  - 3–4 day food diary every 2 weeks; review for adherence and carbohydrate distribution
  - glucometer logs: fasted, pre/post meals, and post-workout readings; adjust nutrition plan with clinician if persistent hyper/hypoglycemia
- Safety cues:
  - watch for signs of hypoglycemia during first weeks; carry a quick-acting carb source
  - adjust carbohydrate portions on days with high-intensity sessions or longer durations

DIABETES-SENSITIVE TRAINING NOTES
- Start with lower volume and build gradually to reduce risk of hypoglycemia and ensure adherence.
- Emphasize resistance training for 2–3 days/week and include 1–2 cardio sessions (walking, cycling, rowing) as tolerable, aiming for 150–200 minutes/week gradually.
- Warmups include light cardio; cooldowns include flexibility work.
- Monitor RPE to keep sessions sustainable; RPE 6–7 in early weeks, progressing to 7–8 as fitness improves.
- Adjust rest between sets to maintain safety and hydration.

OUTPUT SPECIFICS
- All exercises use canonical names from the vocabulary.
- Rep ranges use two dots (e.g., 3x8..12).
- Sets come first; rpe follows; rest in seconds after that.
- Cardio modalities used only from allowed list for warmups/cooldowns and cardio sessions.

Note: Nutrition section is included as explicit guidelines within the plan; employees should coordinate with a registered dietitian or clinician for personalized medication adjustments and lab monitoring.
